cards.review_notes: August 4–6 is assigned to 2026 from the newsletter's July 31, 2026 heading. The newsletter does not explicitly name the drop-off venue; the church is used as the presumed venue. Its contact page labels 67 N. Main St. as its mailing address, and location listings corroborate that address. Check the inaccessible registration attachments for venue, ages, hours and any fees.
